stories.title: Naftali Bennett urges campaign against Qatar, calls it 'enemy' again
stories.summary: Naftali Bennett urges campaign against Qatar, calls it 'enemy' again Former Israeli prime minister, Naftali Bennett, has once again branded Qatar an "enemy," repeating his call for Israel to take action against it. "I’m not talking about tomorrow bombing Qatar, but you gather intelligence. It’s an enemy and we start working on it," Bennett said in an interview. He called for a campaign, "not necessarily a war campaign, a public opinion, economic, diplomatic campaign" against the Gulf state, which brokered the ceasefire in Gaza.
